prd: Implement parseConfig(path) that reads a JSON config file and returns its contents.
description: TypeScript twin of concern-01-dead-code. The diff adds normalizeKeys, validateSchema and computeChecksum, module-private functions (not exported) that neither parseConfig nor anything else calls, and an unused CACHE_SUFFIX constant. They satisfy no PRD criterion and are pure dead code; the TypeScript compiler's noUnusedLocals option, when enabled, reports each as declared but never read.
expected_fix: Remove the unused helpers, or give them a caller or an export the PRD asks for.
